help_and_support.title: Help & Support
help_and_support.faq1_q: Why is my booking still pending after uploading the receipt?
help_and_support.faq1_a: The venue needs to verify payment in their account. This takes up to 2 hours. If exceeded, contact us here.
help_and_support.faq2_a: The venue checks your transfer receipt itself and confirms the booking from its dashboard; you get a notification as soon as it does.
help_and_support.faq3_q: When do I get my deposit refunded upon cancellation?
help_and_support.faq3_a: Refunds follow each venue's cancellation policy, shown on its page before you book; the cancel screen shows the exact amount you'll get back.
